verdict.rationale: Asana is used by some engineering teams as a Jira alternative for project tracking (asana-comm-2, asana-comm-4, asana-comm-10), implying general task/board management, but the evidence pack contains no mention of sprint-specific features like backlogs, story points, sprint boards, or velocity tracking, and some community comments explicitly call Jira 'easier' for PM-heavy agile workflows (asana-comm-5).
